outcome.technical: tests/test_stamp_verification.py only. _judged no longer re-derives anything: it runs the real `red` in process via _red/_run (both gained a keyword-only module=None, M by default) with five seams swapped on the module and restored in finally: _isolated_run (answers each run from _RECORDED by tag via new _RECORDED_SLOT {baseline:head, task:task, second:second, fix:fix}, lays files over with the module's own _lay_over, records rels/stubs handed), _build_throwaway (no worktree), _remove_throwaway (rmtree of the holder red made), leftover_throwaways ([]), and _git answering only ['rev-parse','HEAD'] with a placeholder. So scope (_red_scope), new/absent/stubs, sources, the owed second/fix predicates, sized/budget, fit/start problems and red_verdict are all run_red's own lines; no git subprocess added (rev-parse intercepted, worktree add/remove/list stubbed). _unjudged kept: raised for a run red starts that the record lacks, one started twice, or a recorded run red never starts (a scope refusal included). Payload gains `handed`. sr138 now checks both baseline.stubbed and the stubs actually handed to HEAD's run (helper _new_only_proved), so its label clause is a product fact. New cases jd1 (run_red's baseline stub list emptied in a mutated module copy -> sr138's check fails) and jd2 (owed-fix predicate rewritten to owe none -> _judged raises 'holds the fix run'); helper _mutated_module compiles a fresh module from source and raises unless the anchor occurs exactly once. Suite: 358 cases (was 356), `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_stamp_verification.py` exit 0, three runs. Block timings, sum of block figures: before 133.2s (one run), after 136.8s and 151.5s (two runs some minutes apart, shared machine) - spread larger than any shift, block names unchanged, so .github/sweep-costs.json left untouched. No product edit was needed: the finding's follow-up (extract run_red's pre-run state) is unnecessary once _judged drives run_red itself. Dependants: .github/sweep-costs.json - still correct, no block added/renamed, figures within noise; tests/test__filed_returns.py (_crlf_cases), tools/affected.py (_scan, _worktrees) - those names untouched; tools/sweep-selftests.py, tools/verify.sh, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md reference the path only - unchanged.
outcome.descriptive: Judged red-first cases now run the real run_red with only the throwaway and the runs stood in for, so a change to run_red's inline decisions reaches them.
